decisions.scenario: Checking a Wednesday afternoon train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street on Wednesday, leaving after 13:45.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR8860 leaves Cambridge at 14:01 and arrives at Birmingham New Street at 16:44.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could you tell me the train ID and fare, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The train ID is TR8860, and the fare is £75.10.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a good trip.
